51802.meaning1: having a large following; with a great congregation
51802.commentary: (ANa) mahāparisānan'ti mahāparivārānaṃ uruvelakassapo aggo'ti dasseti. aññesañ'hi therānaṃ kañci kālaṃ parivāro mahā hoti kañci kālaṃ appo, imassa pana therassa dvīhi bhātikehi saddhiṃ ekaṃ samaṇasahassaṃ nibaddhaparivāro'va ahosi. tesu ek'ekasmiṃ ek'ekaṃ pabbājente dve samaṇasahassāni honti, dve dve pabbājente tīṇi sahassāni honti. tasmā so mahāparivārānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mahāparisānaṃ yadidaṃ uruvelakassapo.

51803.meaning1: with a large retinue; having a large following

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? mahāparivāro hoti, mah'āssa honti parivārā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

51805.meaning1: fact of having a big retinue; fact of having a large entourage

examples.text: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mah'ābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.
aṅgārakās'ūpamā kāmā mahāpariḷāh'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

51810.meaning1: large pile of earth; big heap of soil

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, catumahāpathe mahāpaṃsupuñjo. puratthimāya ce'pi disāyaṃ āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā, upahanat'eva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ

51811.meaning1: name of a group of deities

examples.text: ath'āguṃ harayo devā, ye ca lohitavāsino, pāragā mahāpāragā, āguṃ devā yasassino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.
aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.

51814.meaning1: having great merit; extremely auspicious; very virtuous

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rajak'attharaṇaṃ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṃ avaharitvā ārāmaṃ haritvā bhājesuṃ. bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, mahāpuññ'attha tumhe, āvuso.

mahantañ'ca taṃ padumavanañ'cā'ti mahāpadumavanaṃ, mahantī ca sā nadī cā'ti mahānadī, mahanto ca so maṇi cā'ti mahāmaṇi, mahanto ca so gahapatiko cā'ti mahāgahapatiko, mahantañ'ca taṃ dhanañ'cā'ti mahādhanaṃ, mahanto ca so puñño cā'ti mahāpuñño.

51815.meaning1: massive mountain of merit; great mass of good

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi puññ'ābhisandehi kusal'ābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ, ettako puññ'ābhisando, kusal'ābhisando, sukhass'āhāro'ti. atha kho asaṅkhyeyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
devadahaṃ pañcattayaṃ, kin'ti-sāma-sunakkhattaṃ, sappāya-gaṇa-gopaka-mahāpuṇṇa-cūḷapuṇṇañ'cā'ti.

51817.meaningLit: longer (discourse) on the full moon night
51817.commentary: (DNt) mahāpuṇṇamasuttaṃ (ma. ni. 3.85) pana tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇamāya rattiyā aññatarena bhikkhunā puṭṭhena bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ, taṃ majjhimanikāyapariyāpannaṃ.

examples.text: cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sammādiṭṭhi-sakkapañha-saṅkhārabhājaniya-mahāpuṇṇama-sutt'ādayo sabbe'pi vedañ'ca tuṭṭhiñ'ca laddhā laddhā pucchitasutt'antā vedallan'ti veditabbaṃ. evaṃ aṅgavasena navavidhaṃ.

51818.meaningLit: longer discourse on the full moon night

51819.meaning1: great heap of flowers; massive pile of blossoms

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tam'enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākār'antevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya.
sādhu kho tvaṃ anuruddha satta mahāpurisavitakke vitakkesi
yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.

51821.meaning1: auspicious marks of a great man; characteristics of an illustrious being

examples.text: suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.

51823.meaning1: practised by great men; affiliated with illustrious beings

examples.text: ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipāko'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi mahāpurisasevitoti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato
katame aṭṭha dhammā uppādetabbā? aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakkā, app'icchass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo mah'icchassa. santuṭṭhass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa.
tena hi tvaṃ, anuruddha, imam'pi aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkehi, nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino, n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.

51825.meaning1: meditation of a great man; internal dwelling of an illustrious being

examples.text: sādhu, sādhu, sāriputta! mahāpurisavihārena kira tvaṃ, sāriputta, eta'r'ahi bahulaṃ viharasi. mahāpurisavihāro eso, sāriputta, yadidaṃ suññatā.
mutt'āhaṃ sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā, mahābandhanamutto'mhi, nihato tvam'asi antakā'ti.

taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālam'pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.

51830.meaning1: bound by a great bond; chained by a strong shackle
51830.commentary: (PMa) mahābandhanabaddho'ti daḷhattā ducchedattā ca mahantehi bandhanehi baddho. (VINt) mahābandhanabaddho'ti mahatā kilesabandhanena baddho, mahati vā bandhane baddho, kilesabandhanassa ṭhānabhūte bhavacārake baddho'ti attho.

examples.text: baddho'si sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā, mahābandhanabaddho'si, na me samaṇa mokkhasī'ti.

51831.meaning1: freed from a great bond; released from a strong shackle

examples.text: mutt'āhaṃ sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā. mahābandhanamutto'mhi, nihato tvam'asi antakā'ti.

51832.meaning2: having a great power or strong force

examples.text: mahāmatī mahāvīro, mahājhāyī mahābalo, mahākāruṇiko nātho, mahātamapanūdano.

51833.meaning1: having great discernment; of great wisdom; of enormous intelligence

examples.text: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.

51834.meaning1: great Bodhi tree (under which Buddha was awakened)

examples.text: rañño imaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ passantassa pītiyā nirantaraṃ phuṭasarīrassa añjaliṃ paggahetvā ṭhitass'eva mahābodhi mūlasatena suvaṇṇakaṭāhe patiṭṭhāsi

51836.meaning1: sitting in meditation posture under the Bodhi tree

51837.meaning1: name of king Mahāsudassana's peak-roofed hall

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītikūṭ'āgārasahassāni ahesuṃ mahābyūhakūṭ'āgārappamukhāni.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā kūṭ'āgārasahassānaṃ ekaññ'eva taṃ kūṭ'āgāraṃ hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi, mahābyūhaṃ kūṭ'āgāraṃ.

51838.meaning1: with the peaked-roof hall called Mahābyūha as foremost (among them)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītikūṭ'āgārasahassāni ahesuṃ mahābyūhakūṭ'āgārappamukhāni.
mahābrahmuno'pi kho, bhikkhave, atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako tasmim'pi nibbindati. tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pag'eva hīnasmiṃ.
sattakkhattuṃ mahābrahmā, vasavattī tadā ahuṃ, chattiṃsakkhattuṃ dev'indo, devarajjam'akārayiṃ.

51841.commentary: (VINa) paribbaja mahābrahme'ti mahābrāhmaṇa ito disā sīghaṃ palāyassu.

examples.text: paribbaja mahābrahme, pacant'aññe'pi pāṇino, mā tvaṃ adhammo ācarito, asmā kumbham'iv'ābhidā'ti.

51843.meaning1: enormous fearful and terrifying sound; dreadful frightening noise

examples.text: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yassa me sabrahmacārino sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā'ti. tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, avidūre mahābhayabheravasaddo ahosi, apissudaṃ pathavī maññe undrīyatī'ti.

vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

51845.meaning1: carrying a heavy burden; weighed down

51846.meaning1: carrying a heavy burden; transporting a great load

examples.text: vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.
tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā mahābhikkhusaṅgho paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhi-bhikkhusatasahassaṃ.

51848.meaning1: with powerful direct knowledge; having profound higher understanding
51848.commentary: (SNt) mahāvisayattā mahatiyo abhiññā etassā'ti mah'ābhiñño, tassa bhāvo'ti sabbaṃ vattabbaṃ.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa adhigamaṃ upanidhāya aññatitthiya-samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-paribbājakānaṃ adhigamo n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti. evaṃ mah'ādhigamo, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo, evaṃ mah'ābhiñño'ti.

51849.meaning1: fact of having powerful direct knowledge; fact of having profound higher understanding

examples.text: yañ'hi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, satthārā anuggahito sāvako mah'ābhiññataṃ patto'ti.

51850.meaning1: attained powerful direct knowledge; reached profound higher understanding; (comm) recollected more than one hundred thousand aeons more than an incalculable
51850.commentary: (ANa) mah'ābhiññāppattānan'ti mahatiyo abhiññāyo pattānaṃ, bhaddā kaccānā, nāma aggā'ti dasseti. ekassa hi buddhassa cattāro'va janā mah'ābhiññā honti, na avasesasāvakā. avasesasāvakā hi kappasatasahassam'eva anussarituṃ sakkonti, na tato paraṃ. mah'ābhiññāppattā pana kappasatasahass'ādhikaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ anussaranti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ mah'ābhiññappattānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddakaccānā.

51851.meaning1: attained powerful direct knowledge; reached profound higher understanding; (comm) recollected more than one hundred thousand aeons more than an incalculable
51851.commentary: (ANa) mah'ābhiññāppattānan'ti mahatiyo abhiññāyo pattānaṃ, bhaddā kaccānā, nāma aggā'ti dasseti. ekassa hi buddhassa cattāro'va janā mah'ābhiññā honti, na avasesasāvakā. avasesasāvakā hi kappasatasahassam'eva anussarituṃ sakkonti, na tato paraṃ. mah'ābhiññāppattā pana kappasatasahass'ādhikaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ anussaranti.

51852.meaning1: extremely hot; scorching hot; blazing hot

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mah'ābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.

51853.meaning1: mighty doctor; great physician; great healer

examples.text: suyuttavādī dvipadānam'uttamo, mahābhisakko naradammasārathi, cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti, avītarāgena sudunnivārayaṃ.

51854.commentary: (DNa) kālakañcā mahābhismā'ti kālakañcā ca mahante bhiṃsane attabhāve māpetvā āgamiṃsu. (DNt) mahābhismā'ti bhiṃsanakamahāsarīrā.

examples.text: kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.

51855.commentary: (DNa) tesu kālakañcā mahābhismā'ti kālakañcā ca mahante bhiṃsane attabhāve māpetvā āgamiṃsu.

examples.text: kālakañjā mahābhiṃsā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.

51856.commentary: (MNa) mahābhūtānī'ti pathavī-āpa-teja-vāyānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. yena pana kāraṇena tāni mahābhūtānī'ti vuccanti, yo c'ettha añño vinicchayanayo, so sabbo visuddhimagge rūpakkhandhaniddese vutto.

examples.text: katamo c'āvuso, rūp'upādānakkhandho? cattāri ca mahābhūtāni, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.

51857.meaning1: primary states; great elements; earth, water, fire and wind

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, bhikkhu catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ? cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ.

51858.meaning1: primary states; great elements; earth, water, fire and wind

examples.text: katamo c'āvuso, rūp'upādānakkhandho? cattāri ca mahābhūtāni, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.

51859.commentary: (DNa) mahābhūmicālo'ti mahanto pathavīkampo. tadā kira dasasahassī lokadhātu kampittha.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.

51861.meaning1: wealthy; with many possessions; with great property

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo. evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi na bandhanaṃ nigacchati.
mahaddhanā mahābhogā, raṭṭhavanto'pi khattiyā, aññam'aññ'ābhigijjhanti, kāmesu analaṅ'katā.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso mahābhogakulā pabbajito hoti. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi mahābhogakulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na mahābhogakulā pabbajitā'ti.

51863.meaning1: fact of having great wealth; fact of having vast resources

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi mahābhogakulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na mahābhogakulā pabbajitā'ti. so tāya mahābhogatāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

51864.meaning1: fact of having great wealth; richness

examples.text: appesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appesakkhattaṃ upaneti, mahesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahesakkhattaṃ upaneti, app'abhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appabhogattaṃ upaneti, mahābhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahābhogattaṃ upaneti

51865.meaning1: leading to vast wealth; conducive to having many possessions

examples.text: no ce kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati, sace manussattaṃ āgacchati yattha yattha paccājāyati mahābhogo hoti. mahābhogasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.

mahantañ'ca taṃ padumavanañ'cā'ti mahāpadumavanaṃ, mahantī ca sā nadī cā'ti mahānadī, mahanto ca so maṇi cā'ti mahāmaṇi, mahanto ca so gahapatiko cā'ti mahāgahapatiko, mahantañ'ca taṃ dhanañ'cā'ti mahādhanaṃ, mahanto ca so puñño cā'ti mahāpuñño.

51871.meaning1: very intelligent; having a great understanding; great-minded

examples.text: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.

51872.commentary: (VINa) mah'āmattā'ti ṭhān'antarappattā mahāamaccā, te'pi tattha tattha gāme vā nigame vā nisīditvā rājakiccaṃ karonti

examples.text: evaṃ, devā'ti kho so mah'āmatto rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paṭissutvā āyasmato pilindavacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami

51873.meaning1: talk about ministers; discussion about politicians

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mah'āmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ

51875.meaning2: Mahinda Mahāthera who brought the Dhamma to Sri Lanka

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ. tam'enaṃ mahāmigasaṅgho upanissāya vihareyya. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo.
catubbipallāsavasaṃ adhiṭṭhitaṃ, gāmaṇḍalaṃ'va parinesi citta maṃ, nanu saṃyojanabandhanacchidaṃ, saṃsevase kāruṇikaṃ mahāmuniṃ.
kikī'va aṇḍaṃ rakkheyya, cāmarī viya vāladhiṃ, nipako sīlasampanno, mamaṃ rakkhi mahāmuni.

51882.meaning1: state of great confusion; fact of enormous ignorance

51883.meaning1: heavy rain; great downpour; massive shower

examples.text: ayaṃ, bhante, aciravatī nadī diṭṭhā āyasmatā c'eva ānandena amhehi ca. yadā uparipabbate mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho hoti, ath'āyaṃ aciravatī nadī ubhato kūlāni saṃvissandantī gacchati, evam'eva kho, bhante, āyasmā ānando imāya bāhitikāya attano ticīvaraṃ karissati.
yo mahāmeruno kūṭaṃ, vimokkhena aphassayi, vanaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, ye ca bhūmisayā narā.

51885.meaning1: name of an arahant monk chief disciple; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in psychic power
51885.notes: Theragāthā verses 1149-1217 (TH20.1, TH263) are attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā mahāmoggalāno āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca, āraññikeneva nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā ime dhammā samādāya vattitabbā udāhu gām'antavihārinā'pī'ti?

51886.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; chief disciple; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in psychic power
51886.commentary: (AN 1.190) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ iddhimantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāmoggallāno (UDa) mahāmoggallāno'ti pūjāvacanaṃ. guṇavisesehi mahanto moggallāno'ti hi mahāmoggallāno.
51886.notes: Theragāthā verses 1149-1217 (TH20.1, TH263) are attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavāḷaputtagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya kāyagatāya satiyā ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitāya.

51892.meaning1: great delusion; great illusion; enormous confusion

examples.text: avijjā h'āyaṃ mahāmoho, yen'idaṃ saṃsitaṃ ciraṃ, vijjāgatā ca ye sattā, n'āgacchanti punabbhavan'ti.
sace pan'āyaṃ kulaputto mah'āyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavan'ti vattāro, ajaddhumārikaṃ v'āyaṃ kulaputto marissatī'ti

51894.commentary: (CPa) dhammo nāma mahāyakkho'ti nāmena dhammo nāma mah'ānubhāvo devaputto.

examples.text: imesaṃ yakkhānaṃ mahāyakkhānaṃ senāpatīnaṃ mahāsenāpatīnaṃ ujjhāpetabbaṃ vikkanditabbaṃ viravitabbaṃ, ayaṃ yakkho gaṇhāti, ayaṃ yakkho āvisati, ayaṃ yakkho heṭheti, ayaṃ yakkho viheṭheti, ayaṃ yakkho hiṃsati, ayaṃ yakkho vihiṃsati, ayaṃ yakkho na muñcatī'ti.
pun'āparaṃ yadā homi, mahāpakkho mah'iddhiko, dhammo nāma mahāyakkho, sabbalok'ānukampako.
siyā kho pana bhoto rañño mahāyaññaṃ yajamānassa koci'd'eva vippaṭisāro, mahā vata me bhogakkhandho vigacchatī'ti, so bhotā raññā vippaṭisāro na karaṇīyo

tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti, pañca ca usabhasatāni pañca ca vacchatarasatāni pañca ca vacchatarisatāni pañca ca ajasatāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇ'ūpanītāni honti yaññ'atthāya.

51898.meaning1: of great fame; of wide renown

examples.text: mahanto ca so puriso cā'ti mahāpuriso, mahantī ca sā devī cā'ti mahādevī, mahantañ'ca taṃ balañ'cā'ti mahābalaṃ, mahanto ca so nāgo cā'ti mahānāgo, mahanto ca so yaso cā'ti mahāyaso
